method: Pearson/Spearman across all 32 teams, computed from data/*.json (official NFL.com captures). n=32 teams, season through Week 8.

correlations.pair: Team points-for per game (PFpg) vs win%
correlations.interpretation: Pythagorean sanity check: scoring rate should track winning. High r = standings points are skill-consistent, not luck-driven.

correlations.pair: Net points per game (NETpg) vs win%
correlations.interpretation: Point differential vs record — the core 'remove luck' regression anchor.

correlations.pair: Net points per game (NETpg) rank vs win% rank
correlations.interpretation: Rank correlation: robust to outliers (e.g., blowouts).
Passing volume explains scoring. Also used as the documented proxy for same-game QB-performance vs team-total correlation (parlay gate G5).

correlations.pair: Defensive pass YDS allowed/game vs PApg
correlations.interpretation: Pass defense quality explains points allowed — drives QB/WR prop matchup factors.

correlations.pair: Defensive rush YDS allowed/game vs PApg
correlations.interpretation: Run defense vs points allowed — drives RB prop matchup factors.

correlations.pair: Offensive pass YDS/game vs offensive rush YDS/game (game script)
correlations.interpretation: Teams that pass more tend to run less (negative expected) — relevant when pairing QB overs with RB unders in the same game (correlation gate).
